# KS on the Keys

> KS on the Keys is a family-owned halal restaurant and private event venue in South Keys, Ottawa, Ontario, founded in May 1971 by Kelly Swaita and operated today by the Swaita family.

## Key Business Facts
- **Name:** KS on the Keys
- **Founded:** May 1971 by Kelly Swaita (run today by the Swaita family)
- **Address:** 1029 Dazé Street, Ottawa, ON K1V 2G3 (South Keys, close to the Ottawa airport, Hunt Club, Riverside South, and Alta Vista)
- **Phone:** 613-521-0498
- **Email:** RSVP@ksrestaurant.ca
- **Parking:** Free on-site parking
- **Cuisine:** Lebanese, Italian, Chinese, and Canadian comfort food, plus pizza ("Something for everybody")
- **Dietary & Halal:** All chicken and beef served is 100% halal. Extensive vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options available.
- **Hours:**
  - Monday: Closed (available for private group events by arrangement)
  - Tuesday – Wednesday: 11:00am – 8:00pm
  - Thursday – Friday: 11:00am – 10:00pm
  - Saturday: 10:00am – 10:00pm
  - Sunday: 9:00am – 8:00pm
- **Weekend Buffets:**
  - Weekend Breakfast Buffet: Saturday 10:00am–2:00pm & Sunday 9:00am–10:30am ($22.95 adults, $19.95 seniors 65+, $14.95 kids under 12)
  - Sunday Brunch Buffet: Sunday 10:30am–2:30pm ($32.95 adults, $26.95 seniors 65+, $16.95 kids under 12; Festive Sunday Brunch in December $34.95/$28.95/$18.95)
- **Private Event Spaces & Catering:**
  - Private Event Room: Up to 90 guests (ground floor, AV equipment, high-speed Wi-Fi)
  - Semi-Private Mezzanine: 25 to 60 guests (elevator accessible, overlooks restaurant)
  - Private Board Room: 12 to 24 guests (elevator accessible, TV, microphone, speaker)
  - Main dining room seating for smaller groups with no room fee
  - Full-service in-house and off-site halal catering across Ottawa
- **Online Reservations (Up to 10 Guests):** https://www.tbdine.com/book/restaurant/ks-on-the-keys-restaurant?idApp=69099&language=en-us
- **Online Pickup Ordering:** https://order.tbdine.com/pickup/30078/menu
